vb_textbox.text: Hello, This game is mainly a game of luck and intuition, my advice would be to follow a stride, don't alternate after just on try. Many times I would hit a big amount of points and the next 3-4 rounds would all be high so make sure when you feel its going well to stick, as soon as you hit a low number switch to the other side. There is also a side that usually does best that the other, in my case the K side gave beetter points but i think this would vary depending on each round.
